blocks.text: Unilever Beauty & Wellbeing brought six of its beauty and personal care brands together for Beautyland, a two-day creator and affiliate activation held on October 24 – 25, 2026 at Mandani Bay in Mandaue City, Cebu. Designed around interactive brand experiences, the event connected students, content creators, affiliate marketers, and sari-sari store owners with products from Sunsilk, CLEAR, Vaseline, Dove, Cream Silk, and Pond’s, reflecting the company’s effort to bring brand experiences closer to consumers in the Visayas and Mindanao.
